summary: ITER146 Wave A · Lead Pipeline Validation E2E browser automation complete. Backend: pytest test_iter146_lead_pipeline.py 8/8 PASS; aggregate ITER143a/c/d/e+144+144_1+145+146 = 69/69 PASS, zero regression. E2E /begin-partnership: navigated full 3-step wizard (architect → partnership → residential → company → contact) → POST /api/leads/public?tenant_slug=studio returned HTTP 201, success screen rendered in Italian ('Grazie. La tua proposta di partnership è in mano nostra.'), 'Torna al sito' navigates to /. DB row verified with lead_type=professional, onboarding_path=begin_partnership, professional_category=architect, collaboration_intent=partnership, market_sector=residential, company_name='TEST Studio Verdi Architetti', portfolio_url, tenant_id resolved to studio tenant (848354b9-…), locale_code=it-IT, runtime_identity.user_agent + request_host + source_locale=it-IT captured. funnel_events row: stage=lead_captured, event_name=begin_partnership.submit. email_events: confirmation tmpl=partnership_request locale=it-IT sent to lead + internal notifications tmpl=generic locale=it-IT sent to admin@ + demo@. E2E /begin-journey: full 3-step wizard navigated → POST /api/public/journeys/initiate (NOTE: NOT /api/leads/public — this is the legacy private design-journey endpoint, but it does create Account+Contact+Project+Journey AND dispatch lead_captured email — confirmed by pytest test_design_journey_initiate_triggers_emails). HTTP 201, redirected to /journey/welcome/<token>, welcome page Italian. Contact row created in `contacts` table with our email, lead_captured confirmation email sent locale=it-IT. Dark theme verified on desktop (1920x1080). MOBILE BUG FOUND on /begin-partnership viewport 390x844 — see frontend_issues.

minor.issue: runtime_identity.resolved_host and resolved_subdomain saved as NULL even though PLATFORM_HOSTS whitelist resolved tenant to 'studio' from preview host. Only request_host + user_agent + source_locale + utm are persisted. Spec asked resolved_host to capture preview host explicitly.

ui_bugs.issue: MOBILE (390x844) — page background container is TRANSPARENT (page_bg=rgba(0,0,0,0)) so the cream body color (rgb(245,242,236)) shows through. Title text rgba(0.96,0.95,0.93,0.96) and chip text rgba alpha 0.78 become nearly invisible against the cream background (LIGHT-on-LIGHT contrast failure). Desktop (1920x1080) renders correctly dark. Likely a CSS media query gating the dark wrapper on >=md breakpoint only.

integration_issues.issue: Submits to /api/public/journeys/initiate, NOT /api/leads/public as Wave A spec required. Endpoint works (HTTP 201, creates Account+Contact+Project+Journey, dispatches lead_captured email locale=it-IT), but the unified leads-pipeline contract is NOT used by this page → no `leads` row created for private clients arriving via /begin-journey, only a `contacts` row. funnel_events also not written for this path. If the unified contract is intentional split, fine; if it was supposed to be unified per ITER146, this is a regression vs spec.

Page renders in ENGLISH by default (eyebrow 'First Step · Atmosphere', title 'What ambiance are you seeking?') even though tenant default locale is it-IT. The header locale picker shows 'EN-US'. Editorial bundle resolves keys (no raw keys visible), but the locale default appears to follow browser Accept-Language instead of tenant default. /begin-partnership similarly shows EN-US in header but its copy is Italian (eyebrow 'MOOD for DESIGN™ · Partnership', title 'Esplora una collaborazione con lo studio.', success 'Grazie. La tua proposta…' all Italian).

issues: Critical contrast failure (see ui_bugs). Page essentially unusable on mobile.

After dismissing PROFILO PERSONALE modal, page renders 'MODULO DISATTIVATO · Questo spazio è in silenzio. · CRM_ACCOUNTS · DISABLED'. Module is disabled for MOOD Demo Showroom tenant. Cannot verify operational lead display because submitted leads went to 'studio' tenant (preview-host fallback) while admin@ default tenant is 'mood-demo'. CRM UI display assertion COULD NOT BE COMPLETED.

action_items: [HIGH] Fix /begin-partnership mobile dark background — apply dark wrapper background-color at all breakpoints (currently only applied at md+).

[MED] Decide intent on /begin-journey endpoint: should it (a) continue using /api/public/journeys/initiate (legacy full-chain creation) OR (b) switch to unified /api/leads/public with onboarding_path='begin_journey' as ITER146 contract suggests? If (b), update BeginJourneyPage.submit() and ensure `leads` + `funnel_events` rows are created for private clients too.
[MED] Populate runtime_identity.resolved_host and resolved_subdomain when tenant is resolved via PLATFORM_HOSTS preview-fallback so cross-tenant audit trail is complete.

[MED] /begin-journey default locale should follow tenant.default_locale (it-IT) rather than browser Accept-Language, OR auto-redirect to it-IT when tenant default differs and user has not explicitly chosen.

[LOW] Enable CRM_ACCOUNTS module for mood-demo tenant OR document that 'studio' tenant CRM is only accessible via super_admin cross-tenant impersonation — current state blocks operational verification of lead display in UI.
critical_code_review_comments: BeginPartnershipPage.jsx submit() correctly hardcodes tenant_slug=studio for preview hosts and posts the full extended schema. Payload whitelist on backend (routers/leads.py L127-136) accepts all the pro-only fields — clean contract.

_dispatch_lead_emails correctly differentiates partnership_request vs lead_captured template_keys based on lead_type and dispatches Italian-localized internal notifications to tenant_admin/super_admin owners. Verified via email_events table.

Runtime identity capture in routers/leads.py L144-158 misses resolved_host/resolved_subdomain assignment after tenant-fallback path triggers — only request_host is persisted. Recommend explicitly populating these two fields whenever PLATFORM_HOSTS fallback resolves a tenant.

/begin-journey using /api/public/journeys/initiate creates a richer chain (Account+Contact+Project+Journey) but bypasses the unified `leads` table and `funnel_events` instrumentation that /begin-partnership uses. Inconsistent observability across the two onboarding paths.

rca_of_the_issue: Mobile contrast bug RCA: /begin-partnership root container [data-testid='begin-partnership-page'] has CSS that paints the dark background via a media-query-gated wrapper (likely .min-md or similar) that does not apply at viewport <768px. Body color inherits cream from global theme. Fix: ensure the page wrapper has dark background-color at the base style level, not gated by breakpoint. Reproduction: 1) set viewport 390x844, 2) navigate to /begin-partnership, 3) computed style of [data-testid='begin-partnership-page'].backgroundColor returns rgba(0,0,0,0), 4) title text rgba(0.96,0.95,0.93,0.96) is invisible against cream body.
